methodology_notes: Web search/extract backends were unavailable; all research used the r.jina.ai reader proxy against Wikipedia, NVIDIA's own newsroom, and major-outlet pages.
The distinction between admitted (affair), alleged (espionage), and reported-but-denied (obstruction of the Commerce inquiry) was explicitly tracked because every stock conclusion depends on it.
Reuters and NYT article bodies were largely paywalled; their substance was recovered via the Wikipedia citation hub and CNN/AP/FT coverage rather than direct full-text access.
Dates in the events window run through Nov 10, 2026, i.e. after the session-start clock of Nov 3, 2026; the analysis is dated to the latest reporting rather than a stale snapshot.
limitations: This is a fast-moving, developing story; facts as of Nov 10, 2026 may shift materially.
Scenario probabilities are analytical judgment, not empirical estimates.
No determination of wrongdoing has been made; all espionage/obstruction claims remain allegations.
This is informational analysis, not investment advice.
